texts.zh:
针对这种持续的轰炸，我们增强了心智，于是很快就弄明白了原因。

这种爆炸性惊厥是由我们自身所处维度的高浓度灵能能量反射流造成。这一连串危险的精神小泡有可能严重损害没有准备的人的心智。

从中得到了一个洞见：这种强有力的构造可以为从虚境中产出新武器提供基础。
texts.en:
We fortified our minds against this continued barrage and soon understood its nature.

The explosive convulsions are caused by currents of concentrated psionic energy reflected from our own dimension. These volatile beads of psychic intent have the potential to significantly damage the minds of the unprepared.

An insight took hold: these powerful formations will provide the basis for new weaponries borne from the Shroud.

texts.zh:
我们的精神储备已经衰退了。

这种心灵爆炸排山倒海而来，诱发了许多[GetTelepathPlural]的灵能休克。

我们需要时间来恢复。
texts.en:
Our mental reserves have waned.

The psychic detonations were overwhelming, inducing cases of psionic shock in many of our [GetTelepathPlural].

We will need time to recover.

summary.text:
# 灵能轰炸 / Psionic Bombardment

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`events/shroud_events.txt:7389-7553`; `common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:5819-5854 (on_patron_delve_failed: 28 events × 100, utopia.3002 × 1)`; `common/scripted_variables/09_scripted_variables_shroud.txt:8,109-114 (attunement ±50/100/200; 30-year retrigger 10800 days)`
- DLC：Shadows of the Shroud
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

潜入虚境但没有找到其他事件（on_patron_delve_failed）时，从28个权重各为100的遭遇（另有权重1的 utopia.3002 兜底）中随机抽取一个满足条件的；每次潜入失败只出现一个遭遇，不会依次经历全部。要求尚未拥有或可研究“灵能轰炸机”，且处于某位尚未立约的主要赞助者领域；此前非组件类潜入越多、或最近一次组件潜入失败，抽中权重越高。

When a Shroud delve finds nothing else (on_patron_delve_failed), one eligible encounter is drawn at random from 28 candidates of weight 100 each (plus utopia.3002 at weight 1 as fallback); each failed delve shows one encounter, never all of them in sequence. Requires not having (or having as an option) Psionic Bombers, and being in the domain of a major patron without a covenant; its weight grows with previous non-component delves and after a recent failed component delve.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

强烈的痉挛穿过虚境，威胁着我们的灵能者。

Powerful convulsions threaten to overwhelm our telepaths.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

“弄明白”：60→3116 成功，获得灵能轰炸机研究选项；40→3117 失败：灵能冲击修正1800天（机械/蜂巢/其他），30年内不再出现。“离开虚境”：冷却减半。

"We must find out": 60 → 3116 success, Psionic Bombers become a research option; 40 → 3117 failure: a psionic-shock modifier for 1,800 days (machine/hive/other), no recurrence for 30 years. "Exit": cooldown halved.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无。

None.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

对照原文核实了触发、选项与回复事件；草稿结构正确（选项→各自的回复窗口，互斥）。本遭遇与同池其他遭遇相互独立，不应串成一条故事。

Trigger, options and reply events were checked against the source; the draft structure is right (each option → its own reply window, mutually exclusive). This encounter is independent of the others in the pool and must not be chained with them.
